script_text: A tidal wave of cosmic change is crashing into your shell this week, Cancer. Early on, your ruling Moon squares Saturn in your 10th House on Monday, bringing career delays and a harsh boss review, while Tuesday offers relief as Mercury sextiles Venus in your 2nd House boosting money talks. Mid-week, the turning point hits Wednesday when the Sun enters your 1st House, flooding your watery element with self-confidence and visibility. Late week, Mars trines Pluto in your 7th House Thursday sparking passionate love commitments, and the weekend flows gently for home nesting as Neptune soothes your 4th House. Wednesday is your power day because the Sun ignites your 1st House with personal power. Monday is your worst day because Moon-Saturn square blocks career progress. Write down three career goals Monday to outsmart Saturn. Follow for daily updates.
